cost.caveats: Reviewed ceiling for the whole serving arm, not an approval and not an exact spend ceiling; task 7.3 freezes the per-stage limits from these rates and task 9.4 approves them. Requests: one recorded ensemble of 32 draws at temperature 0 per item and rendering. Macro: at most 126 decision months (2016-01 to 2026-06; calibration and evaluation months are disjoint subsets of this window, and the serving arm has no pilot) x 2 renderings x 32 = 8,064. EDGAR calibration: (40 memorized + 100 control) x 32 = 4,480. Negative control: 40 x 32 = 1,280. Smoke run: one ensemble of 32. Measurement posts 8,064 + 4,480 + 1,280 + 32 = 13,856, plus 1 eligibility post = 13,857 inference posts, no retries. Output tokens: 256 per post (the five-loading JSON decision needs well under 100 tokens; the one-component EDGAR outlook needs fewer), so 13,857 x 256 = 3,547,392. Time: 6 s per worst-case post on one A10 (256 decode tokens at about 20 ms each, which is 8.6 GB of bf16 weights read at about 70 percent of 600 GB/s, plus under 1 s for prefill of at most 3,840 input tokens and the proxy round trip), sequential with max_num_seqs 1: 13,857 x 6 = 83,142 s, plus 5 GPU lifecycles (deployment with smoke run, macro calibration, EDGAR calibration, full run, negative control) x 600 s startup = 86,142 s GPU phase. It stays within Modal's 24-hour function timeout including the expiry controller's 150 s allowance (86,292 s). Rate: A10 0.000306 + 4 cores x 0.0000131 + 16 GiB x 0.00000222 = 0.00039392 USD/s. Dry-run worst case: 0.00039392 x (86,142 + 120) = 33.98 USD plus the expiry controller 0.000001915 x (86,142 + 150) = 0.17 USD, total 34.15 USD. Target: all 5 lifecycles' cleanup (5 x 120 s) and controller allowances (5 x 150 s) instead of one, 34.336 USD, rounded up to 34.34 USD. Excludes CPU-only weight staging (its own task 3.5 limit), image build, egress and usage above the requested CPU and memory, which Modal bills when higher than the request. Weights volume about 8.01 GiB x 0.09 = 0.72 USD per month, inside Modal's 1 TiB monthly free volume storage. If throughput is lower, admission closes at the deadline and the run is reported incomplete; it never extends the phase. Monthly provider budgets include prior usage; environment compute budgets differ from workspace coverage. Recheck prices and verify operator allowance before paid approval. Credits are separate from gross cost.

provenance.access: Gated, gated=manual, private=false: the Gemma licence must be accepted on Hugging Face and the pinned files are readable only with HF_TOKEN (by name, from the root .env; task 1.2 receipt hf_gated_revision read config.json at this revision with status 200). The unauthenticated metadata API lists tokenizer.json (33,384,568 bytes), tokenizer_config.json, tokenizer.model, chat_template.json, config.json and two bf16 safetensors shards (4,961,251,752 and 3,639,026,128 bytes; 4,300,079,472 BF16 parameters) at the pinned commit. Architecture Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration. No weights downloaded and no account credentials inspected for this manifest.
provenance.license: Gemma Terms of Use (Hugging Face licence tag gemma), not Apache-2.0
provenance.license_prerequisites: Accept the Gemma Terms of Use on the Hugging Face model page before staging; HF_TOKEN is required by name for the CPU-only weight staging step and is never a serving input. Use is subject to the Gemma Prohibited Use Policy (https://ai.google.dev/gemma/prohibited_use_policy). Any redistribution of the weights must pass on the use restrictions, give recipients a copy of the terms and include the notice that Gemma is provided under and subject to the Gemma Terms of Use; this study serves the weights privately and publishes derived statistics only. Terms page last modified 2026-04-01, checked 2026-11-09.
provenance.gpu_choice: One A10 (24 GB, 600 GB/s, compute capability 8.6, https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/products/a10-gpu/) holds the 8.01 GiB of bf16 weights with room for a 4,096-token KV cache at one sequence. Decode is memory-bandwidth bound: an L4 (24 GB, 300 GB/s, https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/l4/) at USD 0.000222/s needs about twice the time per token, so it costs more per output token (about 9.1e-6 against 6.3e-6 USD) and its ceiling (about 11 s per post) would exceed Modal's 24-hour function timeout. A100-40GB and L40S cost more per second than this model needs. T4 lacks bf16 and FlashAttention support (compute capability 7.5).
provenance.compatibility: vLLM 0.17.0 lists Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration with google/gemma-3-4b-it as a supported model; vllm-project/recipes has no Gemma 3 recipe (Google/Gemma4.md and Google/TranslateGemma.md only, checked 2026-11-09), so the supported-models table is the cited source. Same released linux/amd64 image digest and bootstrap as the GPT-OSS-20B manifests (entrypoint cleared, typing_extensions==4.16.0). Dense bf16 checkpoint: vLLM 0.17.0 has no bf16 quantization method and no none MoE backend, so serving passes --dtype bfloat16 and omits --quantization and --moe-backend (moe_backend none here). Attention FLASH_ATTN: the v0.17.0 FlashAttention backend supports bf16, head sizes up to 256 (Gemma 3 uses 256), sliding windows and compute capability 8.0 or higher, which the A10 meets. --generation-config vllm ignores the checkpoint's sampling defaults so temperature 0 and top_p 1 are explicit. Top-k logprobs with k 5 use --max-logprobs 5 and raw_logprobs; the task 9.4 smoke run must confirm that vLLM returns them for Gemma 3 4B. Weights are staged separately on a CPU-only step into the recall-guard-gemma-3-4b-weights volume (task 3.5). Hardware fit, model readiness, throughput and logprob alignment remain unverified until then. The target endpoint stays null until the deployed app's provider-registered URL is confirmed by the operator.
